Here are the growing conditions for Southern Cordyline seeds in brief two-word numerical answers:

• Temperature: 65-75°F
• Humidity: 50-70%
• Hydrometry: 40-60%
• Sunshine: 6-8hrs
• Rainfall: 30-50mm
• Soil pH: 6.0-7.0
• Soil Type: Loamy 60%
• Drainage: Well 75%
• Organic Matter: 20-30%
